choice_results.independent_solution: A: the figure leaves B direction underdetermined. B: y cross x=-z gives the vertical oscillation axis. C: ((y+z)/sqrt(2)) cross x=(y-z)/sqrt(2) gives tilted B. D is false because nonzero E parallel n=x violates transversality, so the claimed free-space wave is infeasible.

B_I=(E0/c)cos(phi)(x-z)/sqrt(2) oscillates on a tilted line; B_II=(E0/c)(x sin(phi)-z cos(phi)) rotates in xz. Voltages are proportional to E0 cos(phi)/sqrt(2) and E0 cos(phi), both non-identically-zero AC. A falsely removes wave-II rotation, B falsely rejects both AC responses, D falsely copies wave-I E axis into B. C alone has all claims true.
